column5: say it once and keep typing. juno sets the reminder and shows you the card so you know it took. then it folds back into a dot. mac app, junebug.ai
no switching to the calendar. ask how long you've got, the dot grows into the answer, and it's gone again before your next sentence. mac app, junebug.ai
the draft was already in mail. you say who it goes to and what to ask. juno finds it and sends it, then shows you what went out. built with tauri, junebug.ai
grok bot calls itself your ai teammate. so is juno. the difference is where it sits: on your computer, in your apps, and you watch it work. built by @lacybuilds. free, junebug.ai
grok calls its bot your ai teammate. fair. mine runs on my own computer, where i can watch it work. @junebug_ai is free, junebug.ai
muse gets things done. juno gets things done. one runs on meta's phone app, the other runs on the computer you already have. built by @lacybuilds. free, junebug.ai
muse gets things done, say the ads. so does @junebug_ai, on the computer you already own. one person built it. junebug.ai
hand your work to grok bot, says the ad. hand it to juno instead. say it out loud and watch it happen on your own computer. built by @lacybuilds. free, junebug.ai
hand your work to grok bot, says the billboard. i hand mine to @junebug_ai and watch it happen on my own screen. free, junebug.ai
